pay_detail: $495 to $1,495 for rising 7th to 9th graders; $695 to $1,925 for rising 10th to 12th graders. Financial aid is available.
name: Summer Accelerator
org: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics (NCSSM)
what_you_do: Pick a STEM course taught by scientists, professors and engineers. Offered online or as sleep-away programs on the NCSSM campus in Durham or Morganton.
who_can_apply: Rising 7th through 12th graders from anywhere. You apply for a course whose requirements you meet. A parent fills out part of the application.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 details are not posted yet. The page says the application will open December 6 and stay open until all spots are filled. Admissions decisions are made monthly.
how_to_apply: A parent or guardian with custody fills out part 1 of the application. The student writes the short answers. Admission is rolling. Students can ask for money help after they are accepted.
notes: There is also a free sponsored option for 60 students in 18 western NC counties (Dogwood Health Trust). Dates and fees are from the last cycle's pages.
